// diagnostic

E3101

`{op}` can only run inside an `#Unsafe` block.

What

`{op}` can only run inside an `#Unsafe` block.

Why

This operation can violate memory safety, so it must sit in an audited region.

Fix

wrap it: `#Unsafe("why this is safe") { … }`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3101: tests/ui/lowlevel_from_addr_without_unsafe.stderr.

    |          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: this operation can violate memory safety, so it must sit in an audited region
 Fix: wrap it: #Unsafe("why this is safe") { … }
